h1:
Samut Sakhon Moo Kata & Grill
8 Best-Value Dinner Spots
intro: Once the heat fades over Mahachai, plenty of people in Samut Sakhon wrap up the day around a moo kata grill — sat around the dome, refilling endlessly, all starting at just a couple hundred baht. We've pulled together the places locals actually go, with rough prices, neighborhoods, and opening hours so you can pick by budget and the vibe you're after.

blocks.html: Samut Sakhon sits right on the coast, sure — but the easy, wallet-friendly dinner locals tend to meet up over is moo kata and grill buffet. Most of them cluster around the town of Mahachai, along Setthakit Road and the Norraratuthit area, while over in Ban Phaeo and Krathum Baen you'll find canalside spots with a breezier, open-air feel. We've ordered these by value and by what each one suits best — this isn't a ranking of the single "best" place, because everyone's taste runs a little different.

blocks.text: 8 moo kata & grill spots locals actually go to

items.name: Dee Dee Kan Eng Moo Kata Buffet Mahachai
items.blurb: A moo kata buffet near the Tesaban 8 intersection on Norraratuthit Road that Mahachai folks rave about for its punchy dipping sauce, well-marinated pork, and a good spread of ingredients to choose from. The big draw is no time limit on your table — great for a group of friends who want to settle in and talk for hours.
items.meta: Mahachai · Norraratuthit Rd · No time limit

items.name: Tidman Grill & Hot Pan Buffet (Mahachai branch)
items.blurb: A hot-pan grill chain where you can do grill, shabu, and moo kata all under one roof. The spread runs from sliced pork and fresh prawns to liver, cheese, and self-serve sides — a solid pick if you want plenty of options without spending much.

items.name: Godang Mahachai Seafood (Moo Kata & Seafood)
items.blurb: A big warehouse-style place that folds moo kata and seafood into one buffet — prawns, shellfish, crab, fish, pork, and beef across a hundred-odd dishes. Unlimited refills, no time limit, and a good shout for days you want seafood on top of the usual moo kata.

items.name: Moo Kata Khang Khlong Ban Phaeo
items.blurb: A canalside spot on Khlong Ta Kham over in Ban Phaeo, open-air and relaxed like eating round at a friend's place. It's known for cured items like marinated salmon and raw prawns, and there's alcohol on offer — good if you want a laid-back setting away from the town center.
items.meta: Ban Phaeo · Khlong Ta Kham · Open 17:00–23:00
items.price: À la carte / sets, easy on the wallet

items.name: Few Dee Mahachai
items.blurb: A grill spot leaning into a camping theme — chilled-out vibe, a varied menu, and a crowd of younger diners and photo-takers. Easy to sit, eat, and chat away the evening in the Mahachai area.

items.name: Rim Khlong Moo Kata Don Kai Dee
items.blurb: A spot on the Don Kai Dee side of Krathum Baen district that locals there praise for its pork and just-right dipping sauce. Canalside seating gives it some atmosphere — handy if you're over toward Krathum Baen or passing through Phra Pradaeng–Om Noi.
items.meta: Krathum Baen · Don Kai Dee · Canalside

items.name: Baan Ivar Moo Kata & Suki Mahachai
items.blurb: A place that does both moo kata and suki, with big sets built for groups — ideal when there's a crowd of you ordering a platter to share. The dipping sauce is the part a lot of people come back for.

items.name: Tidman Grill Buffet (Ban Phaeo branch)
items.blurb: The Ban Phaeo branch of the Tidman chain, for anyone out in Ban Phaeo district who'd rather not drive into Mahachai. Same grill-plus-shabu menu as the in-town location.

blocks.title: How to pick a spot
blocks.html: Most Mahachai buffets open from late afternoon into the night, and Friday–Saturday around 8pm they tend to fill up. Call to book or show up before 7pm and you'll get a table far more easily — and check the shop's page every time, since buffet prices and promos shift with the season.

Most moo kata buffets in Samut Sakhon land in the 199–299 THB per-head range, drinks not included. Places that add seafood like prawns, shellfish, and crab nudge up toward 299 THB, while drink refills are usually charged separately at around 39 THB a head. For a group of four, the total per meal tends to come out around 900–1,300 THB, depending on the spot and what you drink.

items: Tightest budget (~199 THB/head) — Dee Dee Kan Eng, Tidman's in-town branch; pork, veg, and meatballs, unlimited refills.
Want seafood too (~299 THB/head) — Godang Mahachai Seafood, moo kata plus prawns, shellfish, and crab in one meal.
Big group, all about sharing — Baan Ivar has large sets around 499 THB that split between several people.
After a canalside setting — Moo Kata Khang Khlong Ban Phaeo, or Rim Khlong Moo Kata Don Kai Dee.

blocks.text: Which areas have the most spots?

items.name: Mahachai town
items.blurb: The hub for buffet spots — Tidman, Dee Dee Kan Eng, Few Dee, and Godang Seafood, all easy to reach from the town center.

items.name: Ban Phaeo
items.blurb: The Khlong Ta Kham side, open-air and breezy — good for anyone out toward Ban Phaeo or wanting to escape the bustle of town.

items.name: Krathum Baen–Don Kai Dee
items.blurb: The Om Noi–Samut Prakan side, with canalside spots at friendly prices — handy if you're coming from western Bangkok.

blocks.title: Straight up
blocks.html: The prices, opening hours, and buffet menus in this article are rough figures pulled from reviews and shop pages as of early 2026. Moo kata spots change promos and prices often, and a few are small places that may close for renovation now and then — always check the page or call to confirm before you head out.

faq.q: Roughly how much does moo kata cost in Samut Sakhon?
faq.a: Most moo kata buffets in Mahachai start around 199 THB a head; places that fold in seafood like prawns, shellfish, and crab run about 299 THB. Drink refills are usually charged separately at around 39 THB. It's still good value for a dinner with unlimited refills.

faq.q: Which Mahachai moo kata spots stay open late?
faq.a: Most Mahachai buffets open from late afternoon until 9–10pm — Godang Mahachai Seafood, for instance, runs roughly 15:00–22:00. Canalside spots like Moo Kata Khang Khlong Ban Phaeo open around 17:00–23:00. Check the shop's page before you go, as hours shift by the day.

faq.q: Where can I get moo kata and seafood under one roof?
faq.a: Godang Mahachai Seafood combines moo kata with a seafood buffet in one place — prawns, shellfish, crab, and fish across a hundred-odd dishes, around 299 THB per adult including drinks. A good shout for a day you want both the grill and seafood.

faq.q: What should a big group order?
faq.a: With four or more of you, a per-head buffet works out best thanks to the unlimited refills — or go for a place with large sets like Baan Ivar, which has sets around 499 THB to split between several people. The total per meal usually lands around 900–1,300 THB for four.

faq.q: Is there moo kata over in Ban Phaeo?
faq.a: Yes. The Ban Phaeo side has canalside spots on Khlong Ta Kham like Moo Kata Khang Khlong, open-air and relaxed, plus a branch of the Tidman grill chain — so anyone out toward Ban Phaeo doesn't have to drive into Mahachai.
